variants.en: Man, you're brilliant! How did you fix this laptop in five minutes? Please teach me how.
variants.pcm: Guy, you dey craze! How you take fix this laptop for five minutes? Abeg teach me.
variants.cs: Guy you dey craze o! How did you fix this laptop in five minutes? Abeg teach me.

intended_meaning: Admiring praise to a friend; 'you dey craze' here means 'you're amazing'. Asks how to fix a laptop.
author: claude-draft
